rationale: The css gate's residual over the 400-file stride is 85 = 70 ambiguous references + 15 unresolved imports, and all 15 unresolved are `@import` specifiers carrying NO claim of any kind (`imports  importSource+importSpecifier+isCssImport` with `extClaim 0`) although the analyzer already computed the distinction. The fix publishes the reason on the arbiter's claim channel (`sourcePathClaim` for a network URL, `importProjectFile` for an existing project sibling) — but ONLY when the caller supplied `context.projectRoot`, because both claims are statements about the project's own admitted file list and an analyzer must not invent which list it is judged against. This fixture is the DEGRADED-INVOCATION pin: `run-fixtures.ts:986` calls `analyze()` with no context, so this file pins that NO claim key is invented, no target is reduced to a basename, and the verbatim `importSpecifier` survives. The positive half cannot be pinned by a flat fixture (there is no project root to name); it is asserted instead by `validation/m14/fixtures/css/import-claims-probe.ts` (which calls `analyze()` WITH a project root and hands each claim to the arbiter's own `classifyEdge`, with a control that must refute) and, authoritatively, by the gate's own after run — imports `unresolved 15 -> 0`, `extOK 2439 -> 2454`, `extFAIL 0` (`measurements/gate-css-after-400.txt`). CONTRACT REPIN (2026-10-25): `part_of` is now emitted for the PLAIN FILE FORM of `@import` in the css family — exactly one named child of type `string_value`, no `.css` suffix, no protocol URL, no `sass:`/`data:` scheme. Sass/Less fold that form in at compile time, so it is a source inclusion (`part_of`, `partRole:"library"`), not a stylesheet load. Every other form keeps `imports`: `url(...)` (the child is a call_expression), a media query (a SECOND named child), a `.css` specifier, and any protocol URL. This is a LABEL MOVE — source, target, line and the project-file claim are unchanged.
knownLimitation: A flat fixture cannot exercise the claim path itself: the claim requires a caller-named project root and the fixture runner passes no context. The probe and the gate are the instruments for that half; this file pins the boundary that keeps the change inside the css lane (the html and scss analyzers delegate to this class with three arguments and must stay byte-identical).
